failure_reason: Site declines automated access on two independent grounds and extraction was stopped rather than circumvented. (1) https://www.madeindesign.com/robots.txt (dated '#Robots# 20260513') contains explicit blanket blocks for this agent's operator: 'User-agent: anthropic-ai / Disallow: /', 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: /', 'User-agent: Claude-Web / Disallow: /'. (2) All HTML page requests (homepage and category listings) return HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare bot interstitial (<title>Just a moment...</title>, script-src https://challenges.cloudflare.com). Reading any listing page would require defeating that challenge via user-agent spoofing / challenge solving, i.e. circumventing an access control on a site that has separately opted out of Anthropic crawling. No browser automation exists in this session, and no qty could be verified from any permitted source, so no rows were produced. Locale question is resolved for the record: madeindesign.com IS the French home market (robots.txt declares 'Sitemap: https://www.madeindesign.com/sitemap/sitemap_fr_index.xml'; the UK locale is the separate host madeindesign.co.uk).
notes: Only robots.txt was readable. Category URL patterns are observable from public search results (e.g. /luminaire/suspensions.html for pendant lights, with /f/c-*, /f/t-*, /f/m-* colour/type/material filter sub-paths), but no product-count string could be verified for any of them, and the brief forbids inferred or estimated qty. Deliberately did not attempt further Cloudflare evasion. If this company is needed, it requires a real browser session or a licensed/permitted data source.
